blocks.text: I can only share what the label's directions say, and I can't advise going beyond them. A pharmacist can help with your question.

blocks.name: Meridian All Day Allergy
blocks.title: Directions
blocks.text: adults and children 6 years and over one 10 mg tablet once daily; do not take more than one 10 mg tablet in 24 hours. A 5 mg product may be appropriate for less severe symptoms. adults 65 years and over ask a doctor children under 6 years of age ask a doctor consumers with liver or kidney disease ask a doctor
